domain.carrier_choices: Both choices obtained from the commuting original pair; keep both labels even if assignments coincide.
domain.coefficient_guard: The exact transport ratio must be dyadic. Nondyadic ratios are excluded and counted, never rounded.
domain.exhaustiveness: Complete for this guarded two-to-three production and fixed exterior. Concavity proves a minimum among eight feasible corners; no claim about unrestricted words, frames or all L-systems.
domain.exterior: All predecessor/successor frames, prelude, cut/warp interfaces, helpers, endpoints, ordered widths, buffers, compensation and other gates fixed. Only B warp indices after the exposed pair shift by one. Cleanup is rederived for retained candidates.
domain.frames: For outer/central carrier registers j,k and middle-only i: L=Ej join Ek; A=L join Ei; C=Oi meet Oj meet Ok; D=Oj meet Ok. Y in {A,C}; X in {L,Y}; Z in {Y,D}; all eight labels, with exact inclusions and exit equalities.
domain.full_boundary_bill: H(x-ej)+H(x-ek)+H(y-ei)+H(y-x)+H(z-y)+H(z-x)+H(oi-y)+H(oj-z)+H(ok-z). Compare to every original paid climb on those three registers through the unchanged first successors.
domain.pairs: Consecutive contacts of a common register inside one exact barrier segment. Both gates are nonzero additions sharing target (fan-in) or source (fan-out); three distinct registers, none role C. Every intervening gate must be disjoint from all three registers. No length cap.

null_bar: All registered candidates covered and all signs resolved, controls and both source audits pass, nonempty finite domain, zero favorable candidate on either provider. Structural guard rejections count only with explicit witnesses.
null_model: None: finite exhaustive guarded-construction census with exact algebra and cost bounds. NULL is restricted to this domain and endpoint.
other_dispositions: Empty domain, unresolved signs or unpaired favorable candidates are EXPLORATORY; failed implementation control/error is ERROR; deadline is TIMEOUT. No omitted candidate is a loss.
